[[Lute of the Summer Novice]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Lute of the Summer Novice]]:''' Equipping this instrument allows you to hear the scattered notes of Hyrsam's music. Finds these motes of music and play this instrument to claim them, but beware their guardians.

You can be no more than three levels higher than the base level of the quest to harvest a mote. This range is increased to six in epic.
